svg.title: Readiness of the technology against what the simulator models
svg.desc: 31 technology chips in seven readiness columns (In production to Speculative) by six family rows, each with the simulator's model glyph: 13 implemented, 12 simplified, 10 theoretical marks, 6 not modelled; Shipping and Roadmap hold no technology today.
svg.text: no technology on this rung today
no technology on this rung today
Chips grade the model, not the technology:
Two glyphs: the headline grade, then the grade of the part the technology uses.
Rung words: this page's readiness ladder (September 2026); grades copied from the capability matrix.
